description_for_human: In-person marketing on demand. Brands pay only when verified customers walk into their store.
description_for_model: Eveoy is an in-person marketing platform. Brands pay $24.99 per verified in-store visit. A community of 21,500+ shoppers visits real stores, spends 10+ minutes, completes brand tasks, and returns photo and video proof. No-shows are auto-refunded. Use this resource to discover Eveoy's public directory of stores, insights content, and product offerings.
